headline: Voted 3-0 to enter executive session to screen applicants for City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.
summary: The committee met to screen applicants for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position. Chair Houseman declared that an open meeting would harm the ability to get qualified applicants, and the committee voted to enter executive session. The committee adjourned directly from executive session without reconvening in open session.
decisions: Voted 3-0 (Rotondo-yes, Spang-yes, Houseman-yes) to enter executive session to review applicant resumes and applications for the Budget/Management Analyst position.
